components.name: Primary Button
components.description: The one filled, unbordered surface — reserved for the single most important action per view.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { background: oklch(0.528 0.263 262.9); color: #fff; padding: 8px 16px; height: 36px; border-radius: 8px; border: none; font-weight: 500; font-size: 14px; transition: background 0.15s; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: oklch(0.47 0.24 262.9); } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid oklch(0.528 0.263 262.9); outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-btn-primary:disabled { opacity: 0.5; cursor: not-allowed; }

components.name: Segmented Toggle
components.description: Pay/Receive, True-Data/CCP-Data, chart-type switches. Fill communicates selection; no border in either state.
components.css: .ds-toggle { display: flex; gap: 4px; } .ds-toggle-item { padding: 6px 10px; border-radius: 8px; border: none; background: transparent; color: oklch(0.480 0.020 255); font-size: 12px; font-weight: 600; text-transform: uppercase; letter-spacing: 0.04em; transition: background 0.15s, color 0.15s; } .ds-toggle-item:hover { background: oklch(0.960 0.019 263.0); } .ds-toggle-item.is-active { background: oklch(0.528 0.263 262.9); color: #fff; }

components.name: Input Field
components.description: 1px hairline box at rest; border shifts to Coinbase Blue on focus, no glow ring.
components.css: .ds-input { height: 36px; width: 100%; border-radius: 8px; border: 1px solid oklch(0.872 0.009 258.3); background: oklch(0.985 0.004 247.9); color: oklch(0.240 0.020 255); padding: 0 12px; font-size: 14px; transition: border-color 0.15s; } .ds-input:focus-visible { outline: none; border-color: oklch(0.528 0.263 262.9); } .ds-input::placeholder { color: oklch(0.480 0.020 255); }

components.name: Card
components.description: Flat surface, separated from the page by a single 1px hairline border — no shadow.

components.css: .ds-card { background: #fff; border: 1px solid oklch(0.872 0.009 258.3); border-radius: 8px; padding: 20px; } .ds-card-title { font-size: 14px; font-weight: 600; color: oklch(0.240 0.020 255); margin-bottom: 12px; } .ds-card-body { font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; font-family: ui-monospace, SF Mono, monospace; font-size: 14px; color: oklch(0.240 0.020 255); }

components.name: NPV Figure
components.description: The single Display-scale element in the system: the headline Net NPV number.
components.css: .ds-npv { font-family: ui-monospace, SF Mono, monospace; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; font-size: 30px; font-weight: 700; color: oklch(0.500 0.153 160.9); } .ds-npv-unit { margin-left: 6px; font-size: 13px; font-weight: 400; color: oklch(0.480 0.020 255); }

narrative.overview: This is a desk tool, not a marketing surface: a trader reads a number, trusts it, and moves on. The system is built around one rule — surfaces are flat, separated only by a hairline border or a shift in background tone, never by a shadow. The only saturated color in the whole interface is a single confident blue, spent on the handful of things that are actually actionable; everything else is ink, paper, and hairline gray. Numbers are always tabular so a column of rates or a book of NPVs lines up and scans in a glance, the way a real terminal does.
keyCharacteristics: Flat by default; no shadow except on true floating overlays (popover, tooltip)
One accent color (Coinbase Blue), spent sparingly and only on actionable elements
Hairline (1px solid) borders as the only separator between adjacent surfaces
All monetary/rate figures set in tabular numerals
8px corner radius as the single, uniform rounding value across buttons, inputs, and cards

rules.name: The One Blue Rule
rules.body: Coinbase Blue appears only on elements the user can act on (submit, active toggle, focus ring, active nav). If it's not clickable or currently selected, it isn't blue.

rules.name: The Tabular Rule
rules.body: Any element displaying a monetary amount, a rate, or a P&L figure sets font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums so stacked figures align column-for-column.

rules.name: The Flat-By-Default Rule
rules.body: If it sits in the document flow, it gets a hairline border, not a shadow. Shadows are earned only by elements that visually float above the page.

dos: Do use exactly one hairline border color (#D1D5DB) for every structural separator.
Do round every interactive surface to the same 8px radius.
Do set font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums on every monetary/rate/P&L value.
Do reserve Coinbase Blue for actionable/selected elements only.
Do separate related rows within one panel with a hairline divide-y, not nested cards.
donts: Don't nest a bordered card inside another bordered card.
Don't add a drop shadow to any card, panel, button, or badge that isn't a genuine floating overlay.
Don't use a gradient background or gradient text anywhere.
Don't glue a tiny uppercase tracked eyebrow label above every section reflexively.
Don't show related totals as identical equal-weight boxes instead of an expressed hierarchy.
Don't color-code positive/negative values by hue alone; always pair with a leading sign.
